name: Discrete Transistor — GH
description: Discrete transistor cluster containing 4 parts in the GH package family with SMD and through-hole footprints from the chilaboard-altium-library.
selection_hints: Choosing a discrete transistor in the GH package family.
Targeting footprints GH_3, GH_R_3, GH_R_SMD_3, or GH_SMD_3.
avoid_when: The design requires a package family other than GH.
Parts with quality tiers higher than tier C or planner-visible parts are needed.
Mounting methods other than SMD or through-hole are required.
